title: Decorative fill with the owner's free-line psc-deco-1line.plf at 100 mm
description: A 40 x 40 mm square sewn as decorative fill with an owner-made Decorative Fill pattern (psc-deco-1line.plf: one free line (128,128)-(896,896) of the cell) at 100 x 100 mm, direction 0, run pitch 2.0 mm: the tile is centred on the region, so the line crosses the square from corner to corner, split evenly at the run pitch (1.95 mm), joined by travel along the outline at 2 mm, with the fill's tie-in and lock. PE-DESIGN also sews the line three times and walks parts of the outline repeatedly (292 needle points against OpenStitch's 73); that count is not compared.
